name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's motorsport journey began in the snowy karting tracks of Quebec, where he honed his skills in reading track conditions and optimizing setups for varying weather. His analytical mind and knack for predicting opponent strategies quickly set him apart. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from McGill University, he transitioned to data analysis roles in Formula Ford and eventually found his niche in rally racing.

Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous approach to strategy, favoring data-driven decisions over gut feelings. He meticulously analyzes telemetry, weather forecasts, and competitor data to formulate race plans that maximize performance and minimize risk. His cool demeanor under pressure and ability to adapt to changing circumstances make him a valuable asset to VW Racing Brasil. He's a bit of a lone wolf, preferring to work independently and present fully-formed strategies rather than engaging in brainstorming sessions, but his results speak for themselves.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height, Jean-Pierre carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, with all items in their designated place.
